faqs.question: How should I check a masked Aadhaar copy?
faqs.answer: Open the exported file and verify the first eight digits are fully obscured on every page before sharing. Server-powered job files are removed after the configured retention period (2 hours by default).

faqs.question: Does it work on password-protected e-Aadhaar PDFs?
faqs.answer: Use our Unlock PDF tool first to remove the master password, then mask the first 8 digits.

faqs.question: Are the first 8 digits permanently unrecoverable?
faqs.answer: Yes. True redaction removes the covered text and image content from the output PDF.

routes.title: Convert PDF to Grayscale
routes.meta_description: Convert colored PDF pages to grayscale for monochrome printing. Output size can vary, and image-based pages may not retain selectable text.
routes.intro: Convert colored PDF pages to grayscale for black-and-white printing. Already-grayscale files are preserved; color pages are rendered as images, so file size can increase and their text may no longer be selectable.

faqs.question: Does grayscale conversion reduce file size?
faqs.answer: Not always. Already-grayscale PDFs are preserved, while converting color pages to images can increase file size. Use Compress PDF when reducing size is your goal.

faqs.question: Will text remain selectable?
faqs.answer: Text remains selectable when the source is already grayscale. Color pages are rendered to grayscale images and may need OCR before their text can be searched or copied.

faqs.question: Is the conversion reversible?
faqs.answer: No. Once colored pages are converted to grayscale, their original color data is not recoverable from the output file.

faqs.question: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scanned image PDFs are fully supported and every embedded image is converted.

routes.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields
routes.meta_description: Flatten interactive PDF form fields into the page content online for free. Create a non-editable final submission copy.
routes.intro: Permanently bake all AcroForm field appearances into the page — essential for final submission, archiving, and preventing further editing.

faqs.question: What does flattening a PDF do?
faqs.answer: Flattening converts interactive field widgets into static page content. The PDF looks the same but fields can no longer be typed in.

faqs.question: Can I unflatten a flattened PDF?
faqs.answer: No. Flattening is permanent and irreversible. Keep the original fillable PDF before flattening.

faqs.question: Does flattening reduce file size?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, as interactive form metadata and widget streams are removed.
